PLAN "12-Week Strength and Hypertrophy"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase compound lift strength"
  GOAL secondary hypertrophy:
    name "Build lean muscle mass"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Accumulation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          leg_swings 2m
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x1 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Upper A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          arm_circles 2m
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Lower B":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          leg_swings 2m
          glute_bridge 2m
